title: Document and bound the at-least-once duplicate send risk (no SES idempotency token)
description: SES v2 has no idempotency token and the transport remembers keys in memory, so a crash between the SES call and the delivery write, or a retried invocation on a new container, can send a reply twice. Document the bound in docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.md and add a durable send marker or a conditional write before the call if the risk is not acceptable. Found in the PR 648 review.
